This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a
6-month bases as 
indicated by M6 in the title block

The technical specification of the oil pump : 
capacity Q:8.3-151/s, total head H: 27-34.8m, speed n:2900 rpm, power: 7kw

The pump function is to transfer the oil from tank 
to another or to filtration station or from station to outside.

The first draft is initiated by eng.Mohamed Abd 
Allah Ismail, reviewed by eng. Osman Abd Eldaem,
accepted by Pre. 
general director eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.

Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc

items:
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc

To carry out the outside inspection & to hear the pump in 
 operation before stoppage for the revision for the purpose of normal operation 
 of the bearings, vibrations, and leakage through the sealing joints

To check up the fastening of the pump and electric motor to 
 the base plate and also the state of poundation concrete

text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a
6-month bases as 
indicated by M6 in the title block
The technical specification of the oil pump : 
capacity Q:8.3-151/s, total head H: 27-34.8m, speed n:2900 rpm, power: 7kw
The pump function is to transfer the oil from tank 
to another or to filtration station or from station to outside.
The first draft is initiated by eng.Mohamed Abd 
Allah Ismail, reviewed by eng. Osman Abd Eldaem,
accepted by Pre. 
general director eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump.
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety equipment as 
 safety helmet , shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump.
Use suitable warning boards
Tools and Equipment
Set wrenches and screwdrivers
Kerosene and cleaning material (rag. cloth)
Packing and grease
Work to be Carried Out
To carry out the outside inspection & to hear the pump in 
 operation before stoppage for the revision for the purpose of normal operation 
 of the bearings, vibrations, and leakage through the sealing joints
To make the necessary cleaning
To check up the fastening of the pump and electric motor to 
 the base plate and also the state of poundation concrete
